decisions.reason: The product shows a clear customer value claim with quantified savings, fits the firm's stated push toward modular environmental technology, and after only one year management would strongly continue a visibly invested launch.

A dedicated product page signals visible public commitment, it is close to the core range, and in a growing market management would give this recent launch more time rather than reverse course quickly.

Although market evidence is still limited, this modular plant concept is central to the firm's announced direction and management would likely justify its recent investment by attributing slow traction to normal adoption and project timing.

As a close extension of the established machinery portfolio, this recent launch benefits from sunk development and sales effort, and management would be inclined to persist while the firm is expanding and industry conditions remain favorable.
